name: model_policy_drift

storage.rationale: The safeguard is read-only and persists no host state.

description: Compare resource-owned model policies with live runner catalogs without modifying policy files

models.description: Optional per-runner live model allowlists, keyed by codex, claude-code, opencode or grok.

notes: The running Agent Manager control plane schedules this read-only check every 7 days (maximum 14 days), persists the last result, and files deduplicated scenario-qa reports.
